en.headline: Maritime Carnival continues at Hong Kong Maritime Museum this weekend
en.dek: Free mini carnival and art container exhibition run at the museum's Anchor Plaza in Central, with free museum admission on 21 and 22 November.
body: The Hong Kong Maritime Museum is hosting a free Maritime Mini Carnival at its Jockey Club Anchor Plaza in Central as part of Hong Kong Maritime Week.

The carnival runs on 21 and 22 November with maritime game booths, interactive experiences, and stage performances, according to the museum. An accompanying Project Art Container Exhibition displaying winning entries from a drawing competition is on view from 15 to 25 November.

The museum is offering free admission on 21 and 22 November, with free guided tours available. The organisers said the programme lets visitors explore Hong Kong’s maritime heritage through art and interactive activities.
The venue is at the Hong Kong Maritime Museum on Man Kwong Street in Central. Admission to the carnival and exhibition is free.

zh.headline: 海事嘉年華於香港海事博物館繼續舉行
zh.dek: 免費小型嘉年華及藝術貨櫃展覽於中環賽馬會海事廣場舉行，21及22日博物館免費開放。
body: 香港海事博物館在中環賽馬會海事廣場舉辦免費海事小型嘉年華，作為香港海事週活動一部分。
嘉年華於11月21及22日舉行，設有海事遊戲攤位、互動體驗及舞台表演，據博物館指。同期的藝術貨櫃展覽展出繪畫比賽得獎作品，展覽期由15至25日。
博物館於21及22日免費開放，並提供免費導賞團。主辦方表示，活動讓市民透過藝術及互動體驗認識香港海事遺產。
場地位於中環民光街香港海事博物館。嘉年華及展覽均免費入場。
